source_selection.selection_rationale: Use the first seed in the frozen Experiment-1 v2 confirmation cohort, selected by frozen identity before any Experiment-2 transport outcome is observed. Sensor population, energy operating point, source seed and bundle identity are read from the frozen v2 campaign rather than duplicated here.

transport_baseline.rationale: Freeze the previously live-qualified OAI+srsRAN multi-UE slice path and match the intended OAI+srsRAN N320 physical transport. uesim03 is deployment-only competing traffic and receives no modeled sensors. The first setup-only Open5GS+srsRAN attempt exposed the known srsUE Requested-NSSAI-in-cleartext incompatibility before any Experiment-2 telemetry was replayed, so it produced no transport outcome and is not used as the experiment baseline.

transport_calibration.knee_rule: The first grid rate with end-to-end delivery ratio below 0.98 marks saturation onset; L* is the immediately preceding grid rate. If the first rate already fails or no rate crosses the threshold, the pilot stops without selecting L*.

matched_pilot.background_rate: L* selected only by the frozen transport_calibration rule
matched_pilot.purpose: mechanism/measurement pilot only; not the final confirmation campaign

pilot_objective: Find and freeze a reproducible 5G competing-traffic operating point using a source bundle from the current frozen Experiment-1 v2 campaign before the matched timing confirmation campaign. Do not use transport outcomes to select the source trace.
transport_sequence: resolve and verify the frozen Experiment-1 v2 source bundle
prepare fixed OAI+srsRAN RFSIM scenario with separate competing UE
select L* by the frozen threshold rule
automated native/gap_permutation/periodic pilot at the frozen L*
qualify physical N320 OAI+srsRAN path before any physical confirmation runs
